description: This Java class models a data structure called ExtendedDevice, representing a tuple of devices involved in communication. It holds references to an authenticated device and an origin device, providing context for device communication in a coap adapter setting.

classes.name: ExtendedDevice
classes.description: Represents a pair of devices involved in message communication, including an authenticated device and an origin device.

methods.name: ExtendedDevice
methods.description: Constructor to create an ExtendedDevice with specified authenticated and origin devices.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the device tuple, indicating whether devices are the same or different.
